rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for mass communication channels and institutions, and can also refer generally to the media as an industry.

example.english: The media report this news story all the time.
example.traditional: 傳媒成日報道呢單新聞。
example.jyutping: cyun4 mui4 sing4 jat6 bou3 dou6 ni1 daan1 san1 man4

rows.note: Use this specifically for the content items produced or distributed by media, such as programmes, films, books, and photographs.

example.english: This media content is very suitable for children to watch.
example.traditional: 呢啲媒體內容好適合畀小朋友睇。
example.jyutping: ni1 di1 mui4 tai2 noi6 jung4 hou2 sik1 hap6 bei2 siu2 pang4 jau5 tai2

rows.note: Use this when “the press” specifically means journalists and press professionals rather than media channels or institutions.

example.english: The media reacted strongly to this scandal.
example.traditional: 新聞界對呢宗醜聞反應好大。
example.jyutping: san1 man4 gaai3 deoi3 ni1 zung1 cau2 man4 faan2 jing3 hou2 daai6
